name: Sissy Squat
cues: Hold a fixed support with one hand
Rise onto the balls of your feet
Lean back and let your knees travel forward
Keep your hips straight so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Reads as a sissy squat: hip held ~0, knee 110, trunk 48 deg back, heels 14 to 42 deg up, COM 12 mm behind the balls. One hand stays fixed on the post. Owner should look at the fragile bits: forefoot sinks 46 mm into the floor (tol 50), post-hand wrist deviation reaches -29 with a 97 deg swing in shoulder plane, and the hero is effectively a side view (az -95).
